peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.9% below its local comparables; 55 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (93.1): 6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 377 of 405 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,845,813 ($2,299 psf, 1,237–1,259 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,394 psf (range $1,546–2,761); 3.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $118,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 370 m, Farrer Park MRT about 990 m; closer than 337 of 551 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 220 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 370 m), more than 419 of 551 similar developments (the same as 42); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 480 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 1,220 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 700 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 900 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,090 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,650 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,780 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,920 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,980 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 372 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 84 new sales and 958 resales (1,042 purchases); new sales were 8.1% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 958 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 246 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 958 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 994 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.6%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
